predictions.articleTitle: Decoupling Sandefjord vs Molde: Expected Goals, Away Vulnerability & Match Intelligence
predictions.coreRecommendation: Molde's superior 2.34 xG attacking efficiency should ultimately prevail at Jotun Arena, though Sandefjord's 66.7% home unbeaten record warrants Draw / Away Win coverage.
possibilityAssessment: Molde secures a high-tempo 1:2 road victory as second-half offensive rotations overwhelm Sandefjord's backline (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
Sandefjord maintains compact mid-block discipline to force a gritty 1:1 draw, capitalizing on Molde's 1.6 road goals conceded per match (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
An open end-to-end clash produces Over 2.5 goals as both sides exploit transitional defensive vulnerabilities (Confidence: High, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Molde's elite attack tests Sandefjord's resilient Jotun Arena home record.

spf.comment: Molde possess the attacking edge to claim a 1:2 victory, but Sandefjord's 66.7% home unbeaten rate justifies retaining the 1:1 draw.

over_under.comment: A combined goal expectancy of 3.20 to 3.54 goals and Molde's 2.4 goals-per-match rate strongly support Over 2.5.

score.comment: A narrow 1:2 Molde victory represents the modal outcome, with a 1:1 stalemate as the primary risk branch.

goals.comment: Three goals aligns with the 1:2 baseline, while two goals reflects the compact 1:1 contingency.

bqc.comment: Sandefjord regularly keep home first halves level before Molde's superior bench pushes them across the line in the second half.
